notes.title: V2.0.0 Update: Workshop Supported!
notes.notes:
How to create a local module: 
In the local file location of the game:
 WASDJK → WASDJK-Data → StreamingAssets → Mods 
You can browse all local mods.
The "默认(Default)" folder contains the default WASD images for the game. It is recommended to keep this folder without making any modifications.

In the Mods folder, copy "默认(Default)" or any other mods folder and modify the four WASD images.   Note: Do not change the image file name .
In the game, enter the mods interface, click the "Refresh" option above the local mods list, and select your own local mod.

How to upload local mods: 
In the Mods interface of the game, you need to first select the local mod you want to upload, make it the "Current Mod".
Then click the "Upload to Workshop" button in the upper right corner of the local mods list, enter the mod title and description to upload.
